fields.description: Require a VAT Number (or Registration Scheme + Registration Number) only for VAT registered buyers — VAT Category: Registered, B2B or B2G (see common_util.REGISTERED_VAT_CATEGORIES). Applied only while "Validate VAT No Against All Company" is unchecked.
fields.label: Validate VAT No Against Registered Company

fields.description: Only warn (do not block) when an Address City Name is not in the Saudi National Address list. Keep this unchecked so an inaccurate city name can never reach a ZATCA invoice.
fields.label: Allow City Names Outside the Saudi National Address List

fields.description: Require a VAT Number (or Registration Scheme + Registration Number) for every Company customer in Saudi Arabia, including companies that are not VAT registered.
fields.label: Validate VAT No Against All Company

fields.description: Additional Saudi city names, one per line, accepted as Address City Name. Use it for a locality that is missing from the built-in National Address list.
fields.label: Additional Saudi City Names

fields.description: When enabled, Sales Invoice outstanding is reduced by the retention amount (invoice may show Partly Paid). When disabled, outstanding stays at grand total. ZATCA always receives the full invoice amount either way.
fields.label: Subtract Retention from Outstanding
